content:
rachel: Morning — async standup for Oriole Health renewal/escalation. What I did: confirmed the renewal contract details with legal, pulled last 7 days of webhook error rates; Blockers: customers seeing 502s on deliver endpoint causing retries; Today: coordinating with eng to triage logs and proposing temporary routing to dedicated pool. Pinging @matt-eng for visibility.

david: Thanks. Quick note — renewal meeting next Wed 3pm PT; need a short summary of mitigation steps by EOD tomorrow.

ben: what do we know about scope? Is it all customers or just Oriole?

rachel: looks like Oriole only but same pattern seen in two other smaller customers last week. Error spikes align with their bursty traffic windows.

anya: I can grab the runtime logs and trace chain for the 502s. Can someone share the exact sample request id or timeframe?

cs-bot: ticket INC-1234 created for Oriole Health 502s — owner: eng-oncall, priority: high. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-1234 :ticket:

samir: FYI Oriole is asking for an interim SLA note; they want a mitigation statement by EOD. I'm prepping the customer comms draft.

matt-eng: Adding context — saw a small regression from yesterday's routing change that increased timeouts for requests hitting the legacy deliver path. Will look now.

anya: grabbed logs for 2026-03-15 02:10-02:25 UTC. sample payloads show repeated retries, upstream returning 502. snippet: ```ERROR deliver: upstream=nginx/1.21.6 status=502 id=or-8f3a retry=4 latency=1202ms```

ben: Can we divert Oriole to dedicated pool until root cause fixed? That would stop retries and reduce noise.

matt-eng: We can spin a short-lived dedicated pool and update routing policy for the customer; will need a config change in Console. @anya can you validate that their model/quantization variant is compatible?

anya: Yes — Oriole runs gpt-3.5-small@v2 which is compatible. I can test routing in staging and then sign off for production switch.

rachel: perfect. Action items: 1) @matt-eng create temp dedicated pool + routing rule (target: oriole-asset) 2) @anya validate and smoke test in staging 3) @samir finalize comms draft for EOD 4) @david prepare renewal summary. I'll update the Jira ticket once routing is in place.

matt-eng: started pool creation — ETA ~18 minutes. tagging eng-oncall for the smoke test.

cs-bot: update INC-1234 — status: in_progress, assignee: matt-eng, linked PR: none.

samir: draft comms posted -> https://docs.redwood.com/oriole/renewal-comms-draft please review, short and transparent.

ben: quick ask — if routing change isn't enough, do we want to enable prefix caching for Oriole as mitigation?

anya: possible but needs check on correctness for their workload — will evaluate after routing.

rachel: thanks team. I'll follow up with Oriole after Matt confirms pool ready. Low-churn thread; reply if you need me to block the renewal call. :thumbsup:

matt-eng: pool ready and routing updated. ran smoke tests — no 502s in 10m sample. Posting logs to the ticket.

cs-bot: INC-1234 comment: smoke tests passed, temporary routing active.

rachel: awesome — closing loop here. Next sync if we see reappearance or if Anya's deeper trace identifies root cause.

david: noted — I'll capture the mitigation steps for the renewal doc. Thanks everyone.
